title: Completion payload
description: POSTed server-side to hrms.instance + completion.callback_path, authenticated by the token, with header Idempotency-Key: {ref}. Extraction values pass through unchanged — no renaming, no reshaping. Field mapping belongs in the HRMS.

goal_key.description: The collection's goal_key, echoed unchanged. The resolved provider goal id is deliberately not here: which agent ran is the portal's business, not the hrms's.

stage.description: The collection's stage label, echoed unchanged.

catalogue_version.description: The collection's catalogue_version, echoed unchanged, so the hrms can see which fixture set the answer belongs to.

status.description: The provider's case status, relayed verbatim. review is a normal outcome: documents accepted, case flagged for a human.

result.description: The provider's case result, verbatim: whatever JSON it put there, including a list of checks. Relayed unexamined, exactly like a document's extracted.

extractions.description: Case-level merged extractions, verbatim: shape as well as content is the provider's, so a list is as valid as an object.

document_code.description: The requestedDocument's document_code, or "unfiled" for a bulk upload the candidate never filed.

verification_document_id.description: The provider's id for this document.

detected_document_type.description: What the provider's classifier said the file is, in the provider's own label. Not the HRMS document code.

is_detected_type_expected.description: Whether provider_doc_type matched the requestedDocument's expected type. Null when the requestedDocument declares no provider_doc_type.

low_confidence.description: Soft flag: confidence below features.classifier_confidence_threshold. Recorded, never acted on.
